argv: Walk notes: the place check reads names as written
ops.body: [owner] Walk notes: the place check reads names as written (specs/walk-notes, J1, WN4d). What still passes `scripts/walks.js`: a park, a station or a landmark with no gazetteer name in it, a town, region or country written in lowercase, and a name spelt with another script's look-alike letters; they are left to `/walked`'s rewrite and the owner's look at the stored words. A word list or a stricter check would be a dependency or refuse plain words (GeoNames' towns include "of", "to" and "time").
